nodes.label: SettleLoneVerdictsJob schedule
nodes.rationale: Runs hourly at minute 30 in both production and development. It is the timer behind Reviews::Consensus settling a single uncontradicted verdict after 48 hours — the review outcome that has no second principal to agree with it still has to settle, and a periodic job is what makes the 48-hour rule take effect.

nodes.label: Solid Queue finished-job cleanup
nodes.rationale: Hourly batched clear with a sleep between batches so the cleanup does not contend with appending transactions.
